item.title: Rallying Cry – November 11, 2026
item.description: From veterans serenaded by volunteer musicians and Ethiopia’s coffee exports hitting $870 million to Ghana’s bold plan to clean up toxic waste while creating 20,000 jobs and a legendary ocean liner becoming the world’s largest artificial reef, today’s news is full of hope and progress.
